messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Avoid these words/phrases completely: ['blossom', 'convenience']. Finish with "Select a season that appeals to you." and don’t add anything after it. Write 101 words or more. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.) Include a title at the top. Use "# " at the beginning of the title line.

Write a short blog post about a trip to Japan. End your response with this exact line: "Select a season that appeals to you.". Do not write fewer than 101 words.
